dashboard.label: Query Tester — Monitoring
dashboard.description: Operations dashboard — organized by section with clear titles.

search.query: | inputlookup saved_tests_lookup | eval type=case(validationType="ijump_alert","iJump", testType="query_only","Real Data", 1=1,"Synthetic") | stats count by type
| inputlookup saved_tests_lookup | stats count by app | sort - count

index=_internal source="*query_tester.log" message="* completed:*status=*" earliest=$time_range.earliest$ latest=$time_range.latest$ | rex field=message "status=(?<s>\w+)" | stats count by s | rename s as "Status"

index=_internal source="*query_tester.log" message="* completed:*status=*" earliest=$time_range.earliest$ latest=$time_range.latest$ | eval trigger=if(module="scheduled_runner","Scheduled","Manual") | stats count by trigger
| inputlookup test_run_history_lookup | stats count by ranBy | sort - count | head 15

index=_internal source="*query_tester.log" message="* completed:*status=*" earliest=$time_range.earliest$ latest=$time_range.latest$ | rex field=message "status=(?<s>\w+)" | eval label=if(module="scheduled_runner","Sched","Manual")." ".s | timechart count by label

| inputlookup scheduled_tests_lookup | eval status=if(enabled="1" OR enabled="true" OR enabled="True","Enabled","Disabled") | eval lastRun=if(lastRunAt="","Never",strftime(strptime(lastRunAt,"%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ"),"%m/%d %H:%M")) | eval result=case(lastRunStatus="pass","Pass",lastRunStatus="fail","Fail",lastRunStatus="error","Error",1=1,"—") | table testName app cronSchedule intervalKey status result lastRun | sort status testName | rename testName as "Test", cronSchedule as "Cron", intervalKey as "Interval", status as "State", result as "Last Result", lastRun as "Last Run"

index=_internal source="*query_tester.log" message="* completed:*duration=*" earliest=$time_range.earliest$ latest=$time_range.latest$ | rex field=message "duration=(?<d>\d+)ms" | stats avg(d) as a | eval a=round(a/1000,1)

index=_internal source="*query_tester.log" message="* completed:*duration=*" earliest=$time_range.earliest$ latest=$time_range.latest$ | rex field=message "duration=(?<d>\d+)ms" | stats max(d) as m | eval m=round(m/1000,1)
index=_internal source="*query_tester.log" message="* completed:*status=*" earliest=$time_range.earliest$ latest=$time_range.latest$ | stats count

index=_internal source="*query_tester.log" module="spl.query_executor" message="Executed SPL in *" earliest=$time_range.earliest$ latest=$time_range.latest$ | rex field=message "in (?<d>\d+) ms" | stats avg(d) as a | eval a=round(a/1000,1)

index=_internal source="*query_tester.log" message="* completed:*duration=*" earliest=$time_range.earliest$ latest=$time_range.latest$ | rex field=message "duration=(?<d>\d+)ms" | eval bucket=case(d<2000,"<2s",d<10000,"2-10s",d<30000,"10-30s",d<60000,"30-60s",1=1,"60s+") | eval o=case(bucket="<2s",1,bucket="2-10s",2,bucket="10-30s",3,bucket="30-60s",4,bucket="60s+",5) | stats count by bucket o | sort o | fields - o

index=_internal source="*query_tester.log" message="* completed:*duration=*" earliest=$time_range.earliest$ latest=$time_range.latest$ | rex field=message "(?:test\s+(?<tid>[\w-]+)\s+)?completed:?\s*status=(?<s>\w+),?\s*duration=(?<d>\d+)ms" | eval dur=round(d/1000,1)." s" | eval trigger=if(module="scheduled_runner","Sched","Manual") | sort - d | head 10 | eval ts=strftime(_time,"%m/%d %H:%M") | table ts trigger tid s dur | rename ts as "Time", trigger as "Type", tid as "Test ID", s as "Status", dur as "Duration"
| inputlookup saved_tests_lookup | stats count
| inputlookup scheduled_tests_lookup | stats count
| inputlookup test_run_history_lookup | stats count
| tstats count where index=temp_query_tester earliest=$time_range.earliest$ latest=$time_range.latest$
| rest /servicesNS/nobody/QueryTester/storage/collections/config splunk_server=local | search title="temp_lookup_*" OR title="temp_cache_*" | stats count

| rest /servicesNS/nobody/QueryTester/storage/collections/config splunk_server=local | search title="temp_lookup_*" OR title="temp_cache_*" | eval age_min=round((now()-strptime(updated,"%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S%z"))/60,0) | where age_min > 30 | eval age=case(age_min<60, age_min." min", age_min<1440, round(age_min/60,1)." hrs", 1=1, round(age_min/1440,1)." days") | sort - age_min | table title age | rename title as "Collection Name", age as "Age (stale >30min)"

index=_internal source="*query_tester.log" module="data.data_indexer" message="Indexed batch *" earliest=$time_range.earliest$ latest=$time_range.latest$ | rex field=message "batch \d+-(?<end>\d+) \((?<cnt>\d+) events\)" | timechart sum(cnt) as "Events Indexed"

index=_internal source="*query_tester.log" module="scheduled_runner" (message="Skipping *" OR message="SHC stagger:*" OR message="Not the owner*") earliest=$time_range.earliest$ latest=$time_range.latest$ | eval action=case( like(message,"Skipping%dedup%") OR like(message,"Skipping%already ran%"),"Dedup skip", like(message,"Skipping%already claimed%") OR like(message,"Skipping%another search head%"),"SHC host skip", like(message,"Not the owner%"),"Owner mismatch", like(message,"SHC stagger%"),"Stagger delay", 1=1,"Other") | timechart count by action
index=_internal source="*query_tester.log" log_level="ERROR" earliest=$time_range.earliest$ latest=$time_range.latest$ | stats count
index=_internal source="*query_tester.log" log_level="WARNING" earliest=$time_range.earliest$ latest=$time_range.latest$ | stats count
index=_internal source="*query_tester.log" message="Missed run detected *" earliest=$time_range.earliest$ latest=$time_range.latest$ | stats count
index=_internal source="*query_tester.log" message="SPL drift detected *" earliest=$time_range.earliest$ latest=$time_range.latest$ | stats count

index=_internal source="*query_tester.log" (log_level="ERROR" OR log_level="WARNING") earliest=$time_range.earliest$ latest=$time_range.latest$ | stats count by module log_level | sort - count | head 20

index=_internal source="*query_tester.log" log_level="ERROR" earliest=$time_range.earliest$ latest=$time_range.latest$ | eval short_msg=if(len(message)>120, substr(message,1,120)."...", message) | stats count as "Count" latest(_time) as last by short_msg module | eval last=strftime(last,"%m/%d %H:%M") | sort - Count | head 10 | rename short_msg as "Error", module as "Module", last as "Last Seen"

index=_internal source="*query_tester.log" log_level="ERROR" earliest=$time_range.earliest$ latest=$time_range.latest$ | sort - _time | head 20 | eval ts=strftime(_time,"%m/%d %H:%M:%S") | eval exc=if(isnotnull(exception), substr(exception,1,80)."...", "—") | table ts module message exc | rename ts as "Time", module as "Module", message as "Error", exc as "Exception"
index=_internal sourcetype=splunkd "aiguy" "mode=" earliest=$time_range.earliest$ latest=$time_range.latest$ | stats count
index=_internal sourcetype=splunkd "aiguy" "mode=" "duration=" earliest=$time_range.earliest$ latest=$time_range.latest$ | rex "duration=(?<d>\d+)ms" | stats avg(d) as a | eval a=round(a/1000,1)

index=_internal sourcetype=splunkd "aiguy" "mode=" earliest=$time_range.earliest$ latest=$time_range.latest$ | rex "source=(?<src>\S+)" | eval is_err=if(src="error" OR src="config-error",1,0) | stats sum(is_err) as errors count as total | eval rate=if(total>0, round(errors/total*100,1), 0)
index=_internal sourcetype=splunkd "aiguy" "mode=" earliest=$time_range.earliest$ latest=$time_range.latest$ | rex "mode=(?<m>\S+)" | stats count by m | sort - count | rename m as "Mode"

panel.title: Calls by Source (regex / dict / live / error)

search.query: index=_internal sourcetype=splunkd "aiguy" "mode=" "source=" earliest=$time_range.earliest$ latest=$time_range.latest$ | rex "source=(?<src>\S+)" | stats count by src | sort - count | rename src as "Source"

index=_internal sourcetype=splunkd "aiguy" "mode=" earliest=$time_range.earliest$ latest=$time_range.latest$ | rex "mode=(?\S+)\s+field=(?\S+)\s+source=(?\S+)\s+rows=(?\d+)\s+duration=(?\d+)ms\s+prompt=(?

.+)" | eval dur=round(d/1000,1)." s" | eval p=if(len(p)>60, substr(p,1,60)."...", p) | sort - _time | head 20 | eval ts=strftime(_time,"%m/%d %H:%M:%S") | table ts m f p src r dur | rename ts as "Time", m as "Mode", f as "Field", p as "Prompt", src as "Source", r as "Rows", dur as "Duration"

index=_internal source="*query_tester.log" module="scheduled_runner" earliest=$time_range.earliest$ latest=$time_range.latest$ | eval stage=case( like(message,"SHC stagger:%"),"1. Stagger delay", like(message,"Missed run detected for test%"),"2. Missed run sweep", like(message,"Enqueued test %") OR like(message,"%-run sweep enqueued%"),"3. Enqueued", like(message,"Processing % queued test%"),"4. Processing", like(message,"Skipping %"),"5. Skipped (dedup/SHC)", like(message,"Running scheduled test %"),"6. Running", like(message,"Scheduled test % completed:%"),"7. Completed", like(message,"Resetting stale%"),"X. Stale reset", log_level="ERROR","X. Error", 1=1,"—") | where stage!="—" | stats count as "Events" latest(_time) as last by stage | eval last=strftime(last,"%m/%d %H:%M:%S") | sort stage | rename last as "Last Seen"

index=_internal source="*query_tester.log" (module="query_tester" OR module="core.test_runner" OR module="spl.query_executor" OR module="data.data_indexer" OR module="spl.query_injector") earliest=$time_range.earliest$ latest=$time_range.latest$ | eval stage=case( like(message,"Manual test run started by%"),"1. Started", like(message,"Cache macro scan:%"),"2. SPL analysis", like(message,"Indexed batch %"),"3. HEC indexing", like(message,"Executed SPL in %"),"4. Query executed", like(message,"Manual test run completed:%"),"5. Completed", like(message,"Scenario % failed:%"),"X. Scenario error", module="query_tester" AND log_level="ERROR","X. Handler error", 1=1,"—") | where stage!="—" | stats count as "Events" latest(_time) as last by stage | eval last=strftime(last,"%m/%d %H:%M:%S") | sort stage | rename last as "Last Seen"

| inputlookup test_run_history_lookup | sort - ranAt | head 30 | eval dur=round(durationMs/1000,1)." s" | eval drift=if(splDriftDetected="true" OR splDriftDetected="1","Yes","—") | eval ran=strftime(strptime(ranAt,"%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ"),"%m/%d %H:%M") | table ran ranBy triggerType status dur drift resultSummary | rename ran as "Time", ranBy as "User", triggerType as "Trigger", status as "Status", dur as "Duration", drift as "Drift", resultSummary as "Summary"
